purpose: Defines the norms for exchanging transient, per-process data (requests and results) between a calling SKILL and a custom Agent using identifiers, script-written files, and exit values.
summary: Scope: transient data vs permanent documents, which are covered by the doc access principle
Why prompt and return value are not used: size breakdown, AI relay corruption, unfixed shape
Only identifiers are carried; scripts generate them and decide storage paths
Scripts write the data; AI never assembles JSON; publish once complete
Readers get an absolute path from a script and read the file directly
Values arrive unchanged, including newlines, quotes and non-ASCII
Field meaning is owned by SKILL.md or agent definitions, not carried with values
Decide before writing, no overwrite; exit value "0" signals success, closed error set
No runtime format validation; absolute paths allowed; delete everything after processing
Items each feature decides: identifier makeup, location, fields, error values
tasks: Designing a SKILL to custom Agent data handoff
Writing a script that writes request or result files for an agent
Writing or reviewing agent definitions that receive identifiers
Defining exit values and error value sets for a handoff
Reviewing requirements or designs of features that pass data to agents
title: agent とのデータ受け渡し
